releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body: This release adds centripetal buoyancy adjustments to additional fluid volumes in the Stranger, primarily the diving bell entrance.
releases.bodyZh: 本次更新为陌生人区域的额外流体体积添加了向心力浮力调整，主要针对潜水钟入口。

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body: This release fixes the raft docks, including the dam lift.  They may still fail after certain rough approaches or under extremely high gravity.
releases.bodyZh: 此次更新修复了筏子码头，包括大坝提升装置。在经过某些恶劣航程后或极端高重力环境下，仍有可能失效。
